questions.question: In his letter to scattered believers, the apostle Peter said God's great mercy gave them new birth into what?
The apostle Peter said the inheritance God keeps in heaven for believers will slowly fade away. True or false?
The apostle Peter said tested faith may result in praise, glory and honor for believers at what time?

answers.text: At the revelation of Jesus Christ
At the end of their exile in Pontus
At the gathering of all the churches

questions.question: The Spirit of Christ was in the prophets who searched about salvation. What did He predict about Christ?

answers.text: His sufferings and the glories to follow
His birth and His baptism in the river
His kingdom and the temple He would build
